## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- Claim-3 is the first unsupported premise. The rectangle equivalence only proves ideal preservation **conditional on** the map \(s_\lambda\mapsto s_{\lambda'}\) being multiplicative. The draft neither proves this nor invokes the supplied ring-involution statement at [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 484-485].
- The audit therefore must stop at claim-3, not claim-4. The requested quotient-conjugation target was not established. No finite \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) transition computation was run.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Establish claim-3 exactly: invoke or prove that \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\) is a graded integral ring involution of \(\Lambda\), then prove basiswise that \(\omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}\), including integrality, weight preservation, inverse \(\omega_{q,r}\), and the boundary cases \(r=1\) or \(q=1\).
